scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --filter backend dev" "bun run --filter frontend dev" --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,green
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: bun run --filter backend test && bun run --filter @petrel/shared test && bun run --filter frontend test
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "bun run --filter backend test:watch" "bun run --filter frontend test:watch" "bun run --filter shared test:watch" --names backend,frontend,shared --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter backend typecheck && bun run --filter frontend typecheck
